parameters.description_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain characters that are categorized as letter in Unicode, including letters, Chinese characters, and digits. The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 密钥对名称。必须保持名称唯一性。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https:// 开头。支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
